en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a town square with a church-like building and a tall bell tower or clock tower on the right. Several people, including children and a person with a horse or donkey, are gathered in the square. Traditional multi‑storey houses line the left side of the street. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the place as Pantocratoros Square in Lixouri, on the island of Cephalonia (Kefalonia) in Greece. There is handwritten text across the top and a printed website watermark at the bottom.
